## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 29, 2026 - Oct 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kaye Handlon_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "I've been using this app for a few years now and while I know updates can be a little disturbing till you figure out how they've changed things. but this last update where you can't see your macros per meal without jumping through several screens, it's just ridiculous. I used to have the paid version but for whatever reason I saw no value in it. I'm fine with seeing the ads but geez, jumping through three different screens just to see my by meal macros is just annoying."
            2. _WP M_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "Moving more and more features behind the paywall is ridiculous. The most recent example = previously being able to view each meal from the diary separately, with the macro breakdown/pie chart for each one, but now "Macros by Meal" is only available with a premium subscription. So far I've just dealt with the other changes because of all the time I spent creating custom food items and meals, but this is a step too far. Switching to another app is now more than worthwhile. Smooth move MFP."
            3. _Amanda Gauvin_, Sep 30, 2026, 3/5: "years ago I used this app when everything was free. just redownloaded. I'm not paying for premium to use the barcode scanner. that's annoying"
<!--/ir-theme-->
